description.fun: Crabrawler is a boxer crab that always wants to be on top, in rank and in height: it clings to buildings, and even to tall people, and starts swinging if anyone tries to pull it down. It punches trees to knock down Berries, and when a crowd of Crabrawler gathers under one, only the last crab standing gets to eat. Its pincers look like boxing gloves, and one eye looks permanently bruised.
description.guide: Crabrawler is a Fighting-type crab Pokémon from Alola, based on the coconut crab and a boxer. It is fiercely competitive, fights with glove-like pincers that grow back if they break, and loves Berries. It evolves into Crabominable.
description.tagline: A boxing crab that always fights its way to the top

description.fun: Crabominable is what happens when a Crabrawler aims for the top and gets lost on a snowy mountain: it adapted to the bitter cold and grew a coat of thick white fur, like a yeti. Its pincers store cold and hit hard enough to smash ice walls and stop avalanches, and in a pinch it fires them off like rockets. It's the only Pokémon that is Fighting and Ice.
description.guide: Crabominable is a Fighting- and Ice-type Pokémon that evolves from Crabrawler, based on the yeti crab and the yeti. It is impulsive and slow-moving but punches with immense power, freezing foes with icy bubbles. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Crabominable, added in the Mega Dimension DLC for Pokémon Legends: Z-A.
description.tagline: A furry yeti crab with rocket-powered fists

description.fun: From the Mega Dimension DLC for Pokémon Legends: Z-A: bulkier, standing on icicle-encased back legs, with spiked ice maces on its pincers and a mane of white hair hiding its face. A light swing pulverises reinforced concrete, and two of them fighting could wreck the whole area.

note.text: In Sun and Moon, Crabrawler had to level up on Mount Lanakila, the peak at the top of Alola's Victory Road, a boxer literally fighting its way to the top; later games use an Ice Stone. Crabominable is said to be a Crabrawler that got lost climbing a snowy mountain and grew fur against the cold.
